summary: Verify GitHub repository redirects before preserving mappings

delivery.outcome: Preserve repository-bound mappings across provider-verified GitHub redirects without trusting local aliases or publishing across unrelated/reused names. Protected exact-head publication and installed runtime verification.
nonGoals: File watcher changes owned by ticket-185

architecture.decision: A fresh GitHub metadata query and stable numeric repository identity attest the configured/canonical route. The state factory verifies the previous binding and aliases before atomic migration under the existing state lock, retaining concurrent mappings and non-secret fields. Scoped inbound/outbound/reconciliation share this factory; dry-run performs no identity verification or state migration.

dataChanges.description: Add non-secret numeric repository_id and verified name aliases to existing ignored sync state; retain readable v2 mappings.

architecture.rollback: Revert protected merge; preserve existing sync state mappings and aliases.

validation.evidence: Legacy and bound redirects, reused names, mismatched IDs, unverified aliases, concurrent mapping preservation, no secrets/dry-run effects, real non-mutating GitHub redirect observation and protected current head/base merge.
